items.title: Classic Spaghetti Bolognese
items.instructions:
1. Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté onion and garlic until soft.
3. Add ground beef, cook until browned. Stir in tomato paste, tomatoes, and oregano.
4. Simmer 15–20 minutes, season with salt and pepper.
5. Serve over spaghetti with basil and parmesan.

items.title: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
items.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
2. Mix olive oil, garlic, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
3. Rub chicken with mixture; stuff cavity with lemon halves.
4. Roast 60–75 minutes until juices run clear.
5. Rest 10 minutes before carving. Serve with pan juices.

items.title: Vegetarian Buddha Bowl
items.instructions:
1. Cook quinoa per package directions.
2. Toss sweet potato with olive oil, paprika, salt; roast at 200°C (400°F) for 20–25 minutes.
3. Massage kale with a little olive oil and salt.
4. Assemble bowls with quinoa, roasted sweet potato, chickpeas, kale, and avocado.
5. Drizzle with tahini dressing.

items.title: Shrimp Tacos with Slaw
items.instructions:
1. Mix mayo, lime juice, salt, and pepper; toss with cabbage to make slaw.
2. Season shrimp with chili powder and cumin; sauté in olive oil until pink.
3. Warm tortillas.
4. Assemble tacos with shrimp and slaw. Serve with extra lime.

items.title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
items.instructions:
1. Heat olive oil; sauté onion and garlic until translucent. Add mushrooms and cook until browned.
2. Stir in rice; toast 1–2 minutes. Deglaze with white wine.
3. Add warm stock one ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed before adding more.
4. When creamy and al dente, stir in butter and parmesan. Season to taste.

items.title: Grilled Steak with Chimichurri
items.instructions:
1. Combine parsley, oregano, garlic, olive oil, vinegar, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper to make chimichurri.
2. Season steaks with salt and pepper; grill to desired doneness.
3. Rest steaks 5 minutes; serve with chimichurri spooned on top.

items.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
items.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F). Whisk flour, baking soda, and salt.
2. Cream butter with sugars; beat in eggs and vanilla.
3. Mix in dry ingredients, then chocolate chips.
4. Scoop onto baking sheet; bake 10–12 minutes until edges are golden.

items.title: Thai Green Curry
items.instructions:
1. Heat a spoon of coconut milk with curry paste until fragrant.
2. Add remaining coconut milk; bring to simmer. Add chicken and cook through.
3. Stir in vegetables; cook until tender-crisp.
4. Season with fish sauce and sugar. Garnish with basil and serve over rice.
